netflix.title: The Last Salute
netflix.overview: Chronicles the MiG-21's final chapter in the Indian Air Force, showcasing stories of generations of fighter pilots who flew it.

amazon-prime-video.title: Honor Thy Mother
amazon-prime-video.overview: After years of estrangement, a mother and daughter find themselves on opposite sides of a bitter contest for what each believes is rightfully hers. Old wounds resurface as they weigh whether to confront the past together or let it drive them further apart.

amazon-prime-video.title: Barreda
amazon-prime-video.overview: In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

apple-tv.title: Last Seen
apple-tv.overview: When emergency dispatcher Ian Ridley receives a frantic call from a teenager he believes could be his long-missing daughter, he stops at nothing to find her.

apple-tv.title: Mayday
apple-tv.overview: Lieutenant Troy Brennan's reconnaissance mission over Soviet territory goes awry, forcing him to crash-land and survive in Russian wilderness while evading capture or rescue.

apple-tv.title: The Dynasty: UConn Huskies
apple-tv.overview: Explores the history and the recent win by UConn Huskies Women's Basketball team of the 2025 NCAA National Championship, through a mix of archival footage and interviews.

disney-plus.title: 2026 Disney Legends Awards Ceremony Live!
disney-plus.overview: Live from Anaheim, California, the Disney Legends Awards Ceremony at “D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event” celebrates an extraordinary class of Disney Legends receiving the company’s highest honor. Honorees include Chris Berman, Jerry Bruckheimer, Susan Egan, Eric Goldberg, Anne Hathaway, Bob Iger, Kim Irvine, Dwayne Johnson, the Jonas Brothers, Lin‑Manuel Miranda, and Alan Tudyk. Hosted by Emmy® Award-winning Ryan Seacrest, this unforgettable ceremony features heartfelt tributes, surprise moments, and inspiring stories honoring the icons whose creativity, talent, and vision have shaped Disney magic for generations.

disney-plus.title: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration
disney-plus.overview: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration at Disneyland Resort brings together the largest gathering of Disney Princess stars ever assembled, celebrating the iconic stories across animation, live-action, stage, and music. This one-of-a-kind concert will transform the night skies with dazzling lights, sweeping projections, and sky-high fountains creating a truly immersive world where the music, magic, and legacy of Disney Princesses shine like never before.

hbo-max.title: A Killer Story
hbo-max.overview: Investigative journalist Joe Sexton looks into a 2002 double homicide case in Kansas after receiving thousands of emails from Eileen Umbehr, a homemaker turned citizen sleuth. Eileen and her husband Keen are convinced that Dana Chandler, the woman accused of killing her ex-husband and his girlfriend, did not commit the crime and devote their lives to fighting for Chandler's innocence.

mubi.title: God Is Shy
mubi.overview: During a train ride, Ariel and Paul pass the time sketching their deepest fears. Their game takes an unexpected turn when Gilda, a mysterious passenger, intrudes on their exchange. Yet, her relationship with fear seems far less innocent than their playful drawings.

bloodstream.title: Disappear
bloodstream.overview: Between work shifts and concrete streets, a boy moves through a life that feels still and suffocating. An unexpected encounter fractures his routine and sparks a transformation destined to change the way he sees the world forever.
